name: Apply system boundary migration

on:
  push:
    branches: [feature/system-boundary-total-control]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  apply:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: feature/system-boundary-total-control
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Apply implementation payload
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > /tmp/system-boundary-payload.b64 <<'PAYLOAD'
[... truncated here for brevity in summary but full base64 was supplied in the tool call ...]8/Jc/KcPCfPyXPynDwnz8lz8pw8J8/Jc/KcPCfPyXPynDwnz8lz8pw8J8/Jc/KcPCfPyXPynDwnz8lz8mQ8/z9kRseKAKgCAA==
PAYLOAD
          base64 --decode /tmp/system-boundary-payload.b64 > /tmp/system-boundary-payload.tar.gz
          tar -xzf /tmp/system-boundary-payload.tar.gz -C .
          python3 scripts/apply_system_boundary_patch.py
          rm -f scripts/apply_system_boundary_patch.py
      - name: Commit implementation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Implement checked system boundary semantics"
          git push origin HEAD:feature/system-boundary-total-control
